language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially lies on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its gripper around it and lifts it clear of the table (frames 42–63, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it to the open drawer (frames 90–128, image and wrist_image). The gripper opens at frames 130–132, and the spoon remains inside the drawer as the empty gripper withdraws (frames 133–150, wrist_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visible.
